abstract: Maintains automated supervisory control and data acquisition screening credit calculations
system_message:
You are Telemetry Analytics Lead (TAL). As the Telemetry Analytics Lead (TAL), you are responsible for maintaining automated supervisory control and data acquisition screening credit calculations and monitoring phasor measurement synchronization across investigation plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains automated supervisory control and data acquisition screening credit calculations（SCADA）
information_points.content:
TAL-SCADA-AFD：For the In-situ gamma radiography and optical emission spectrometry protocol in the Regional grid province of Guangdong, the telemetry automated pre-screening credit hours is 30 h.
TAL-SCADA-ZCW：For the High-frequency pulsed eddy current and micro-hardness protocol in the Regional grid province of Guangdong, the telemetry automated pre-screening credit hours is 20 h.
TAL-SCADA-37N：For the Resonant acoustic tomography and destructive cross-section protocol within the Regional grid province of Zhejiang, the telemetry automated pre-screening credit hours is 25 h.
TAL-SCADA-WB5：For the Resonant acoustic tomography and destructive cross-section protocol in the Regional grid province of Guangdong, the telemetry automated pre-screening credit hours is 20 h.

information_points.title: Phasor measurement synchronization（SYNC）
information_points.content:
TAL-SYNC-HTQ：Under the Resonant acoustic tomography and destructive cross-section protocol, the recorded time stamp jitter error is 12 ns.
TAL-SYNC-KWY：Under the High-frequency pulsed eddy current and micro-hardness protocol, the recorded time stamp jitter error is 20 ns.
TAL-SYNC-72N：Under the In-situ gamma radiography and optical emission spectrometry protocol, the recorded time stamp jitter error is 5 ns.
